top_signals.title: Why Japan Is Splurging on Jewelry as the Yen Weakens
top_signals.summary:
Japan's luxury jewelry market boom isn't just about fashion.

Instead, consumers are turning indulgence like jewelry into a hedge against a weaker yen. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
